name: Sage & Linen
brief: Calm sage and linen, olive-grove light, soft watercolour botanicals.

image_prompts.paper_tall: Flat top-down scan of a sheet of fine handmade cotton paper, warm white, very subtle soft fibre texture, extremely low contrast, perfectly even diffused light, no shadows, no objects, no folds, no border, no deckle edge, uniform texture filling the entire frame edge to edge
image_prompts.seal: Top-down product photograph of a single oval wax seal, taller than wide, sage green wax with a slight satin gloss, an embossed olive branch with leaves in the centre, slightly irregular rounded rim, centred, isolated on a pure white background, soft studio light
image_prompts.sprig_tall: Watercolour painting of a single vertical eucalyptus sprig with round leaves, muted sage green and grey-green, delicate loose brushwork, the stem runs straight from bottom to top, centred, isolated on a pure white background, no shadow, no text
image_prompts.wreath_sage: Watercolour painting of a round wreath of eucalyptus and olive leaves, muted sage green, thin delicate branches forming a complete circle, large empty open centre, centred, isolated on a pure white background, no shadow, no text
image_prompts.divider_leaf: Watercolour painting of one very thin straight horizontal olive branch with many small sage green leaves, a slender leafy garland stretching from the left side to the right side, delicate, centred, isolated on a pure white background, no shadow, no text
image_prompts.bullet: Watercolour painting of a simple pair of two small sage green olive leaves joined at one short stem, minimal, centred, isolated on a pure white background, no shadow, no text
image_prompts.vinyl: Top-down product photograph of a black vinyl record with a plain sage green centre label, fine grooves with a soft light reflection, perfectly round, the whole record visible, centred, isolated on a pure white background, soft studio light, no text
image_prompts.rings: Product photograph of two plain wedding bands made of matte brushed yellow gold with a soft satin finish, lying together side by side, slightly overlapping, seen from slightly above, centred, cut out and isolated on a pure white background, completely shadowless even lighting, no shadow, no reflection, no engraving, no markings
image_prompts.pin: 3D render of a single map location pin marker, matte sage green, smooth teardrop shape with a round hole in its head, soft clay material, straight front view, upright, centred, isolated on a pure white background, soft studio light
image_prompts.photo_hero: Close-up photograph of the joined hands of a couple in the exact centre of the frame, a man and a woman holding hands, linen sleeves, softly blurred olive grove behind them, golden hour backlight, warm muted film look, muted greens, shallow depth of field, no faces
image_prompts.photo_story: Photograph of a couple walking away from the camera hand in hand along a path through an olive grove, seen from behind, small figures in the centre of the frame, late golden hour, warm muted film look, muted greens, soft calm darker tones
image_prompts.photo_venue: Photograph of an outdoor garden wedding ceremony, a wooden arch decorated with eucalyptus greenery and white flowers in the centre, rows of wooden chairs on both sides of a central aisle, tall cypress trees behind, Tuscany, soft golden hour light, warm muted film look, no people
image_prompts.photo_hotel: Photograph of a Tuscan country villa hotel, warm stone facade with sage green shutters in the centre of the frame, a gravel drive lined with tall cypress trees, soft late afternoon light, warm muted film look, no people, no text
image_prompts.photo_registry: Dark moody still life photograph, one gift box wrapped in natural paper with a sage green silk ribbon in the centre, eucalyptus branches beside it, on dark green linen cloth, low key lighting, deep shadows, muted colours, film look
image_prompts.photo_couple: Photograph of a couple sitting close together in a meadow, seen from behind, in the centre of the frame, looking at rolling Tuscan hills, warm evening light, golden hour, muted film look, tall grass in the foreground in soft shadow
